review.tagline: Local long-term memory store for agents with verbatim storage and semantic search
review.summary: MemPalace stores conversation history as verbatim text and retrieves it with semantic search, organized into wings (people, projects), rooms (topics) and drawers (original content). It ships a CLI, 47 MCP tools, a SQLite temporal knowledge graph, and auto-save hooks for Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor. ChromaDB is the default backend; sqlite_exact, rust_exact, Milvus, Qdrant and pgvector are selectable.
review.audience: Users of Claude Code, Codex or MCP agents wanting local persistent memory
strengths: Raw retrieval scores 96.6% R@5 on LongMemEval with no LLM or API key
Pluggable backends: Chroma, SQLite exact, Rust, Milvus, Qdrant, pgvector
Benchmark results and reproduction commands are committed in the repository
Optional OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint, including local LM Studio, llama.cpp or Ollama
weaknesses: Native Termux install unsupported; Android needs a Debian PRoot container
Stores verbatim text only; no summarization or fact extraction
First embedding call downloads a model of about 80 to 300 MB
GPU Docker image is not published and is x86_64-only
needs: Needs ChromaDB (default backend), ONNX Runtime, Optional: Milvus, Qdrant, PostgreSQL with pgvector
